title: Westport Fuel Systems celebrates Autogas Day 2026
summary: Bart Van Aerle to speak at Autogas Day in Istanbul
body_markdown:
**On 15 October, as part of Istanbul’s Liquid Gas Week, the global autogas sector will come together to celebrate the benefits of LPG for mobility**


On **15 October 2026** , as part of **Liquid Gas Week** – taking place in **Istanbul from 12 to 16 October – Autogas Day** will be celebrated: the international day dedicated to promoting and highlighting Autogas as a mobility solution.


The initiative was launched to celebrate the **benefits of LPG for transport** and to raise awareness amongst the general public, industry professionals and international stakeholders regarding the contribution that Autogas can make towards more accessible and sustainable mobility.


Today, **over 27 million motorists worldwide** use LPG in their vehicles. LPG is **the third most widely used motor fuel globally** and one of the most accessible alternative fuels, thanks to its widespread availability and the potential to keep running costs down.


Compared with traditional fuels, LPG helps to **reduce emissions** , with almost negligible levels of particulate matter and lower emissions of CO₂ and pollutants such as NOx. Its potential as a modern fuel for transport is also set to evolve further with the growing availability of **LPG from renewable sources.**


**Bart van Aerle to speak at Autogas Day**


Autogas Day will also provide an important opportunity for **Westport Fuel Systems** to contribute to the international debate on the future of LPG mobility.


Our **CEO, Bart Van Aerle, will be among the speakers at the event** , delivering a presentation on the **global Autogas market** , its key dynamics and concrete opportunities for growth in key markets.


Westport Fuel Systems’ participation forms part of the company’s presence at **Liquid Gas Week 2026,** one of the leading international events dedicated to the liquid gas sector **.**


**A GLOBAL CELEBRATION**


Autogas Day provides an opportunity for the entire international LPG supply **chain to share knowledge, experiences and success stories,** whilst raising awareness of the benefits of Autogas and the opportunities this technology continues to offer.


**Westport Fuel Systems will play a leading role at Autogas Day 2026 in Istanbul** , alongside its international network, to foster dialogue on the evolution of Autogas and its role in mobility today and tomorrow.
